summary: A Bondi Junction laser and skin clinic appears to lose patients to typos, awkward treatment names and a limited new patient path.

findings.problem: The header appears to read Dr Cosima Medipa, and a treatment name appears as Cellulite Reductiom.
findings.cost: Spelling errors in the clinic name and treatments hurt trust at a premium price.

findings.problem: Treatment names appear to carry Bondi Junction on the end, such as Byonik: Bondi Junction Laser and Rejuran Treatment Bondi Junction.
findings.cost: Stuffed names read as unnatural and make the menu hard to scan.
findings.fix: Clean treatment names with location handled in the page structure.

findings.problem: The page appears to say new consultation spaces open only once per month.
findings.cost: Patients who want to start now may book another clinic instead.
findings.fix: A waitlist that captures their details, plus instant booking.

findings.problem: No WhatsApp appears and only one phone number appears.
findings.cost: Younger patients choose clinics they can message in seconds.
findings.fix: WhatsApp or chat on every treatment page.
